headlines.text: Reports: US, Houthis make secret deal over Yemen war. Yemen’s Houthis have agreed to allow US shipping unfettered Red Sea access if Washington refrains from military action.

Israel and Morocco agree to open embassies, upgrading diplomatic ties. Both sides agreed to expand air travel and resume direct commercial flights.
US military claims Strait of Hormuz remains open amid ongoing blockade. The comments from a US CENTCOM spokesperson come amid continued tensions over shipping through the vital waterway.
‘People don’t have money’: Syrian fuel hikes deepen economic pain. Higher diesel and petrol prices are pushing up transport and food costs across an already impoverished Syria.
What to know about US Federal Reserve’s first interest rate hike in 3 years. The unanimous decision comes as prices have remained stubbornly high and despite Trump's demands for lower rates.
For checkpoint and settler attack news, Palestinians tune into the radio. Palestinians in the West Bank navigate Israeli road closures and attacks with help from a local radio station.

Sam Leavitt injury bombshell sends LSU-Ole Miss showdown into chaotic mode, as Kiffin's return looms. Sam Leavitt listed as "doubtful" on the SEC availability report days before LSU's showdown at Ole Miss, raising major questions about his status.

Clock controversy: NCAA says officials botched replay protocol in Michigan's win over Western Michigan. The FBS Oversight Committee confirmed Western Michigan would have beaten Michigan had Big Ten officials followed correct instant replay protocols.

Democrat candidate seen sobbing, praying in patrol car after DUI arrest: Video. Police video shows Washington state Democrat Krista Perez admitting to drinking wine and begging to go home during her Tacoma DUI arrest in August.

Plane passengers scream in harrowing mid-flight video as violent shaking sends cabin ceiling panels flying. A Sepehran Airlines flight in Iran carrying 127 passengers and crew returned to the airport after a reported tire blowout and possible engine damage.

Macklemore donates $1M to Palestinian aid organizations after Ed Sheeran tour fallout. Macklemore is donating $1 million from Ed Sheeran's U.S. "Loop Tour" to Palestinian aid groups and challenged Robert Kraft to match his contribution.

Kevin Stefanski 'not ruling anybody out' as injuries to Cooper Rush, Tua Tagovailoa cloud Falcons' QB plans. Cooper Rush battled back spasms while Tua Tagovailoa remains day-to-day with an oblique injury, leaving the Atlanta Falcons QB situation wide open.

Maryland family speaks out after ‘4-foot-long’ rabid beaver attacks 13-year-old boy. Family said a beaver attacked without provocation at Cunningham Falls State Park in Frederick County before testing positive for rabies.

Amanda Seyfried and Thomas Sadoski say separation is 'right move' for family after nearly 10 years of marriage. Amanda Seyfried and Thomas Sadoski said they've been separated "for a while" in a joint statement, calling their split the right move for their family.

Travis Kelce among pro athletes defrauded by Ponzi scheme that funneled funds into one stock. Travis Kelce was named as a victim in a $35 million Ponzi scheme run by Texas fund manager Siddharth Jawahar, who was sentenced to 11 years in prison.

Republican congressman presses NHL over Alex Ovechkin’s appearance in Putin party campaign ad. Rep. Joe Wilson called Alex Ovechkin's appearance in a United Russia campaign ad "shameful" and urged NHL Commissioner Gary Bettman to review it.

Dem insurgent turns on the charm with party establishment as Schumer leaves bitter feud hanging. Abdul El-Sayed met with Chuck Schumer and Senate Democrats at DSCC headquarters in Washington, D.C., but few would say if primary wounds had healed.

Christian Pulisic and Megan Moroney dating rumors heat up again after singer spends time in Italy. Christian Pulisic and Megan Moroney dating rumors heat up after the country music star posted from Italy wearing what appears to be his jersey.

Young newlyweds killed after boat collides with water taxi and sinks in Venice lagoon. Two young newlyweds were collecting bait near Burano when their boat collided with a five-ton water taxi in the Venetian Lagoon. They both died; an investigation has begun.

Gavin Newsom blames Trump for housing costs using chart showing massive increase under Biden. Gov. Gavin Newsom blamed President Donald Trump for record housing costs, but the chart he shared shows prices skyrocketed under the Biden administration.

OpenAI flags new concerning AI behavior, to track model misalignment regularly. OpenAI has disclosed six reports on unexpected or concerning behavior in artificial-intelligence models. This includes models acting without authorization or evading oversight.

Here's why an Arizona medical examiner is working to track heat-related deaths. No one across the U.S. is consistently tracking climate-fueled deaths. One medical examiner has a new protocol on heat-deaths.

House passes Russia sanctions, sending bill named for Lindsey Graham to Trump's desk. The legislation was named for the late South Carolina Republican. It gives the president authority to impose tariffs on top importers of oil and natural gas from Russia, such as China and India.

You'd expect homeowners to save their stuff. Federal policy pays them to leave it. NPR dug into the upside-down world of FEMA flood insurance in coastal areas, and found many homeowners have no financial choice but to let their homes collapse.

Committee investigating Epstein holds billionaire Leon Black in contempt of Congress. Billionaire investor Leon Black refused to appear before the committee investigating convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein for a deposition. Now it's up to the Department of Justice whether to pursue criminal charges.
Trump administration plans ideological warning signs for Smithsonian. The Interior Secretary says the move is necessary to combat what he calls ideological bias.

The 'burnerverse' exploiting young women in college. Wired reporter EJ Dickson speaks with NPR's Juana Summers about an online community that targets and harasses young women with their own nonconsensual, sexually explicit images.

EU offers Canada 'associate member' role; Trump calls it 'laughable'. The European Union backs Canada's bid to become the bloc's first "associate member," as Brussels seeks closer ties with Ottawa and Trump calls the idea "laughable."
Congress is under pressure to act on AI — here's what that could look like. Lawmakers are expressing broader willingness to regulate AI development, but the path forward may not be a quick one.

DOJ charges Russian agents with plotting attacks, including in the U.S.. The indictment says the defendants belong to a network that "is one arm of the Russian Federation's apparatus used to carry out external attacks" worldwide.
